title: Coding Team QA-to-Release Handoff
description: Handoff manifest from QA Verify step to Release Pack step. Release agent must not proceed if overall_status is 'fail'.

overall_status.description: Summary result from QA verify. Release step must block if value is 'fail'.

verified_artifacts.description: List of artifact paths that passed QA review. Release pack uses this as the authoritative artifact list.

warnings.description: Non-blocking issues found during QA. Included in release notes.
